Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class Parameters.Builder<T extends Parameters.Builder<T>>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Parameters.Builder<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the concrete builder type.
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    ClientParameters.Builder, ServerParameters.Builder
    Enclosing class:
    Parameters
    public abstract static class Parameters.Builder<T extends Parameters.Builder<T>>
extends Object
    Base builder for configuring common KDC communication parameters. Protocol-specific parameter builders extend this class to provide additional configuration and create the corresponding parameter object.

      • withBindAddress

        public T withBindAddress​(int port)
        Sets the local port to which the communication entity binds, using the local loopback address as the bind address. A port of 0 allows the system to automatically assign an available port.
        Parameters:
        port - the local port, from 0 through 65535.
        Returns:
        this builder.
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the port is outside the range 0 through 65535.

      • withWhiteList

        public T withWhiteList​(List<String> whiteList)
        Sets additional class and package entries permitted during deserialization. An entry containing a fully qualified class name permits that class. An entry ending with a period, such as "com.mycompany.", permits classes whose fully qualified names begin with that package prefix. A wildcard entry ("*") permits all classes.
        Parameters:
        whiteList - the class and package whitelist; must not be null and must not contain null or blank entries.
        Returns:
        this builder.
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if whiteList is null, or contains a null or blank entry.

        Returns:

      • addWhiteListEntry

        public T addWhiteListEntry​(String whitelistEntry)
        Adds a class or package entry to the deserialization whitelist. An entry containing a fully qualified class name permits that class. An entry ending with a period, such as "com.mycompany.", permits classes whose fully qualified names begin with that package prefix. A wildcard entry ("*") permits all classes. Adding a specific entry removes an existing wildcard entry.
        Parameters:
        whitelistEntry - the class or package whitelist entry to add; must not be null or blank.
        Returns:
        this builder.
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if whitelistEntry is null or blank.
